scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/buyer && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/buyer
scripts.lint: npm run build:contracts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && node --test scripts/staging-smoke.test.mjs scripts/canonical-flow-contract.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
